M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE.Purpose: Read-only coordinate conversion over the geometry snapshot published by the engine.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: World, self, child and inverse matrix queries from WidgetGeometrySnapshot.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: ToScreen, ToLocal and TryToLocal coordinate conversions.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Layout computation — owned by M-WIDGET-ENGINE and SS-FLEXBOX.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Clip snapshot construction is owned by M-WIDGET-GEOMETRY; clip queries are owned by M-CLIP-SERVICE.

Requirements.REQ-001: Queries consume published geometry without rebuilding it or reading live widget Props.
Requirements.REQ-002: TryToLocal rejects missing or singular geometry.
Requirements.REQ-003: Pointer targeting is owned by WidgetHitTester in M-FLEX-EVENTS.
Requirements.REQ-004: TransformService has no dependency on ClipService.

Inputs.IN-002: Widget and local or screen point.

Outputs.OUT-001: World matrices, projected screen bounds and inverse local coordinates.
Outputs.OUT-002: Conversion failure for missing or noninvertible geometry.
